story-context.title: Bulk Point Entry
story-context.design-philosophy:
"How did they ever do their job without this?"
Bulk actions should be 3 clicks + 1 confirm - not a chore. When a teacher says "Everyone who finishes early gets +5 bonus points," the system should make that happen in seconds. This frees up teacher time to focus on students, not data entry.
story-context.summary: Add multi-select checkboxes and a bulk actions toolbar to the Room Roster table. Staff can select multiple students, choose an adjustment (+10, +5, -5, -10, -15), confirm the action, and apply it to all selected students at once. Uses the same adjustment model as individual point entry from Story 3-2.

use-cases.case: "Class had a rough morning. If everyone gets back on track this afternoon, I'll add +5 to everyone."
"Great behavior during the assembly - everyone gets +10 bonus."
"Period 3 was chaos. 8 students need a -5 deduction."

acceptance-criteria.ac: Custom bulk entry - preset values cover use cases
Success toast with count of updated students

key-decisions.decision: Use additive adjustments (+5, -5) NOT final totals (Set to 8). Matches Story 3-2 mental model. Teachers think "give +5", not "calculate adjustment to reach 8".
5 preset values (+10, +5, -5, -10, -15) - no custom input. Hick's Law: fewer choices = faster decisions.
Story 3-2 removed unique constraint to allow multiple entries per period. Bulk action creates new rows, doesn't replace existing.
Each student gets their own daep_daily_points row. Maintains full audit trail, consistent with single-entry pattern.
